cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 80% of AI names green

cards.headline: AI Applications & Data Software leads, AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech lags
cards.body: Strongest AI sector is AI Applications & Data Software at +6.72%; weakest is AI Platforms, Internet & AdTech at +0.11%. Rotation within the AI trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: PUBM is the standout at +33.38%
cards.body: Leaders: PUBM +33.38%, SPCX +15.82%, OKLO +14.36%, DV +12.97%, SOUN +12.43%. Laggards: TTD -21.74%, INOD -4.05%, SKHY -3.94%, ANET -1.78%.

cards.headline: SpaceX (SPCX) +15.82% at $133.1

cards.headline: DV moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: DV is +12.97% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.

cards.headline: Risk: AI bubble index 50 — Neutral
cards.body: The composite AI Bubble Index sits at 50/100, led by Valuation at 85. Higher = frothier; the risk is everyone caring at once while valuations are already stretched.
